name: l2cap_le_connection_response
prototype: int l2cap_le_connection_response(void *channel, void *peer, int id, int result, int credits, int mtu, int mps)

ownership.argument: Response builder used by both the inbound request path and the accept/reject decision path, so it is the single place a module should read the response layout from.

provenance.source: Allocates an 18-byte frame with 0xC7EAFBC(18, 8) and writes the LE Credit Based Connection Response: code 0x15 at element+4, identifier at +5, 10-byte payload length at +6, destination cid at +8, MTU from channel+52 at +10, MPS from channel+62/+60 at +12/+14 and the offered credits at +16; a null peer sends dcid 0xFFFF. Eight call sites, all inside the LE CoC connection paths.

notes: Response builder used by both the inbound request path and the accept/reject decision path, so it is the single place a module should read the response layout from.
